test_factorize: test the DatetimeIndex.factorize method to encode unique values as integer codes with optional sorting
test_factorize_preserves_freq: test that DatetimeIndex.factorize preserves the frequency attribute on the resulting index
test_factorize_tz: test that DatetimeIndex.factorize preserves timezone information when factorizing repeated datetime values
test_factorize_dst: test DatetimeIndex.factorize handles DST transition periods correctly for US/Eastern timezone
test_factorize_no_freq_non_nano: test DatetimeIndex.factorize without a fastpath by using a non-nano unit and verifying code and unique index output
